days_to_first_harvest.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for rabi crops
days_to_first_harvest.quote: with 39.3 per cent oil content. It matures in 140 days.
days_to_first_harvest.note: Raya (mustard) hybrid PHR 127; other raya varieties take 136-152 days.

spacing_row_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for rabi crops
spacing_row_cm.quote: Toria, raya, African sarson and taramira are sown in 30 cm and gobhi sarson in 45 cm apart rows

water_need.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for rabi crops
water_need.quote: Raya and gobhi sarson should be drip irrigated at 7 days interval
water_need.note: Every 7 days: read as 'low'. Agronomist to confirm.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for rabi crops
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: Its average seed yield is 7.3 quintals per acre with 41.5 per cent oil content.
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.note: Lowest irrigated raya variety (RLC 3): 7.3 q/acre = 730 kg / 4047 m² = 0.18 kg/m².

source_notes: AI research batch 11 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table (SLBC); other values are TNAU/PAU guides (Tamil Nadu, Punjab) until a local source is found.
